result.summary: The page layout is mostly consistent, but the 'Trattoria Piccolo' card title is cut off at the edge in a way that also truncates its delivery/time info below the visible frame differently from the other cards, and the second 'Popular right now' item lacks a visible title/details before being cut by the viewport, which is inconsistent with the first item in the same list that shows full info before the cutoff point.

issues.description: The second item in 'Popular right now' (pizza image) has no restaurant name, rating, or delivery info shown before the card is cut off, unlike the first item (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) which shows full details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent information density is loaded for each list item, even if visually cut off by scroll position.
